name: Scroll Map
author: jgarza
description: Mini-map of this monitor's active-workspace windows for the Hyprland scrolling layout. Cells are sized in proportion to each window's on-screen width, ordered by position, and the stretch inside the viewport is underlined.

barWidget.description: Proportional mini-map of the scrolling-layout windows on the active workspace.

schema.label: Maximum strip width
schema.description: Longest the mini-map is allowed to get, in logical pixels. On a vertical bar this caps the height instead.

schema.label: Minimum window cell
schema.description: Smallest a single window cell can shrink to, so narrow windows stay clickable. Lower values keep the mini-map more true to scale.

schema.label: Cell gap
schema.description: Space between window cells in logical pixels.

schema.label: Cell label
schema.description: What to draw inside each window cell.

options.label: None
options.description: No glyph — just the cell and its viewport underline.

options.label: App icons
options.description: The resolved application icon, first class letter when none resolves.

options.label: Nerd Font glyphs
options.description: A Nerd Font glyph matched from the window class, generic window glyph when unmatched.

options.label: Short name
options.description: The window class truncated to a few characters.

schema.label: Short-name length
schema.description: Characters shown per cell in short-name mode. Ignored by the other label modes.

schema.label: Cell style
schema.description: How each window cell body is drawn.

options.label: Outline
options.description: Transparent interior with a thin border on every cell.

options.label: Bars
options.description: No cell body - only the viewport and focus tick under each window.

schema.label: Dim unfocused windows
schema.description: Fade every cell except the focused window.

schema.label: Mark on-screen windows
schema.description: Underline the windows currently inside the monitor's viewport and fade the ones scrolled off the edges.

schema.label: Animate changes
schema.description: Fade and slide cells as windows open, close, and move. Turn off for an instant, static strip.

schema.label: Include floating windows
schema.description: Add floating windows to the strip, slotted in by position and drawn with a dashed outline. Off by default since the scrolling layout only tiles.
